name: job-card
title: Maintenance job card
for_each: select id,title from work_orders where status not in ('done','cancelled')

sections.title: Work instruction
sections.note: Follow the approved site procedure. This record is not a permit to work.

sections.title: Procedure checks
sections.sql: select name,result,evidence,checked_by from procedure_steps where work_order_id=$1

sections.title: Recorded labour
sections.sql: select t.name,l.hours,l.note from labour l join technicians t on t.id=l.technician_id where work_order_id=$1

sections.title: Completed maintenance
sections.sql: select title,completed_at,completion_note,isolation_ref from work_orders where asset_id=$1 and status='done'

sections.title: Inspections
sections.sql: select inspector,inspected_on,next_due,result,evidence from inspections where asset_id=$1 order by inspected_on desc
sections.note: Retain source certificates with this record. No fitness certification is issued by this document.

name: purchase-order
title: Draft parts purchase order
for_each: select id,name from purchase_orders where status='ordered'

sections.title: Purchase details
sections.sql: select p.name,p.supplier,x.name as part,x.sku,p.quantity,p.unit_cost,p.quantity*p.unit_cost as total,p.currency,p.expected_date from purchase_orders p join parts x on x.id=p.part_id where p.id=$1
sections.note: Draft only. Review supplier, quantity and terms before ordering. Nothing is sent.
